summary: Collapsible sections tested end-to-end on web (390x844) for personal profile and public user profile. All 28 assertions PASSED across 3 flows. Test 1 (personal, 17/17): prefs-section and history-section present, prefs-body and history-body both absent when collapsed, toggle Pressables visible; tapping prefs-section-toggle expands prefs-body with pref-chip-politica and pref-chip-musica plus prefs-edit-button; tapping history-section-toggle expands history-body with filter-all/majority/minority chips and 3 history-<feud_id> items rendered; re-tapping prefs-section-toggle collapses body (prefs-body count=0). Regression: profile-avatar, profile-badge, profile-edit-button and logout Pressable all still visible. Test 2 (public, 8/8): user_34c2f036bb2e — public-history-section renders, public-history-body count=0 initially, tap expands (public-filter-*, 3 public-history-feud_* items), re-tap collapses. Anonymous user profile — public-history-section count=0 and public-anonymous card renders instead. Test 3 (anon personal, 3/3): anon-lock-screen renders, prefs-section and history-section both absent. Lazy-load confirmed via UI: history items only appear after history toggle is expanded. Only warnings in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (React Native web upstream, non-blocking). No red screen, no runtime errors.
action_items: Minor spec/code mismatch: review_request references testID 'logout-btn' but current code uses 'profile-logout' (line 490 of profile.tsx). Element works correctly, but consider aligning naming (either rename testID to 'logout-btn' or update spec) to match the request.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx is 761 lines — above the 700-line soft threshold. Consider extracting PrefsSection, HistorySection and the two Modals into separate components under src/components/profile/. Non-blocking.
user/[id].tsx (390 lines) cleanly hosts the new collapsible logic; history load effect correctly gates on !profile.is_anonymous && historyExpanded (lines 63-70). Lazy-load semantics respected.

profile.tsx history load effect (lines 57-59) fires on filter change even when historyExpanded is false only via the historyExpanded guard — verified in code: `if (historyExpanded) loadHistory(filter)` is correct. Efficiency optimization confirmed.
sectionCountBadge uses colors.muted; contrast on cream surface is acceptable but the number '12' in the badge could be visually stronger (letterSpacing 1) — cosmetic only.
